migration_status_gate.decision: es2-audit recursively parses every migration JSON document and fails the release if any forbidden terminal state is present.

hidden_source_rooms.reason: No inbound source reference or interaction exists in the fixed commit; it remains cataloged for provenance but is not exposed as a playable room.
An unreachable duplicate of book_room1; the reachable source room is retained instead.
An unreachable duplicate of book_room2; the reachable source room is retained instead.

reachability.decision: The release audit exposes three explicitly excluded source rooms as hidden and counts all remaining 549 source rooms as non-hidden regional content. Existing M4-M7 route and regional gameplay regressions remain the executable acceptance evidence for conditional and scripted paths.

runtime_topology.decision: Every runtime exit must resolve to a registered location or an explicit random-target candidate. Source-only defects are retained in their historical ledgers but removed from the actionable world graph.

source_exits_excluded_from_runtime.reason: The fixed source commit has no room.c; the source yell action names an invalid destination.
This is an external wizard-only destination with no paired room in the shipped single-player world.
The fixed source commit has no guildhall room definition; the historical M6 ledger records the missing reference.

task_acceptance.decision: The M8 task tests cover issuance, expiration, completion, reward settlement and v29-to-v30 save migration; unavailable source targets are filtered before issuance and listed in m8-quests.json.

platform_acceptance.linux: CI runs formatting, Clippy, all-target tests, catalog regeneration, the M9 audit and a release build.
platform_acceptance.windows: CI runs all-target tests and a release build on windows-latest before packaging.

deferred_history.decision: Older ledgers retain deferred as historical provenance. M8 resolved their lifecycle and command dependencies; the release exclusion artifact lists every deferred, excluded and source_noop entry with its original ledger location.
